svg.title: Hearing loss: the Weber and Rinne together split conductive (ear canal; otitis media; a fixed or broken middle ear) from sensorineural (sudden, an emergency; gradual and symmetric; one-sided and progressive, a vestibular schwannoma until proven otherwise); each column gives presentation, investigations and treatment, with otitis media complications, other sensorineural causes and hearing physiology below

svg.text: Hearing loss: is sound BLOCKED before the cochlea, or is the cochlea or nerve DAMAGED?
